Notes for the knowledge base engine.

The plain text splitter merges paragraphs greedily until the chunk limit is reached.
It keeps the original line ranges so citations can point back into the file.

中文备注：纯文本按空行分段，贪心合并到一千二百字符，重叠一百二十字符。

Second English paragraph: retrieval is BM25 first, dense second, hybrid when both are available.
